messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: The glass diver swims through a shattered mirror into the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: A jagged mirror frame stands in a cobblestone square; the glass diver emerges, helmet gleaming, coat reflecting broken city lights.

scenes.caption: Mara the Cartographer unfurls a map in a collapsed hall.
scenes.visual_description: Mara stands under a crumbling arch, ink-stained coat catching dust motes, brass compass in hand, studying a parchment map.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp flickers to life on a stone pillar.
scenes.visual_description: An oil lamp with a single glowing eye in the flame sits atop a mossy pillar, casting eerie shadows on ruined walls.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector snores behind a stack of ledgers.
scenes.visual_description: A drowsy figure slumped over a ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves, in a roofless chamber of the old treasury.

scenes.caption: The tin fox scampers ahead through a broken gate.
scenes.visual_description: A small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes leaps over rubble under the rusted portcullis of a castle gate.

scenes.caption: Mara and the glass diver meet at the fountain plaza.
scenes.visual_description: A dried fountain surrounded by fallen banners; the glass diver and Mara exchange nods as the oracle lamp hovers nearby.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of a cursed tower ahead.
scenes.visual_description: The lamp's eye narrows, flame casting red light on a twisted spire that looms through mist.

scenes.caption: The group approaches the cursed tower's base.
scenes.visual_description: Cracked steps lead to an iron-bound door; ancient symbols glow faintly on the stone; the tin fox sniffs the threshold.

scenes.caption: Inside, the sleeping tax collector has wandered in and dozes on a pile of old tax rolls.
scenes.visual_description: A circular room with crumbling shelves; the tax collector sleeps atop a heap of dusty papers, stamped forms stuck to his sleeves.

scenes.caption: The glass diver peers through a window into a locked chamber.
scenes.visual_description: The diver presses a gloved hand to a frosted window, seeing a shadowy room beyond; his helmet fogs slightly.

scenes.caption: Mara finds a secret passage marked on her map.
scenes.visual_description: She traces a line on the parchment, then pushes a loose stone; a hidden doorway grinds open, revealing a dark corridor.

scenes.caption: The tin fox triggers a trap but escapes unscathed.
scenes.visual_description: A pressure plate clicks; a net of chains drops from the ceiling, but the tiny fox darts aside, key-wind tail spinning.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp reveals a magic door that only opens at dusk.
scenes.visual_description: The lamp's flame casts a beam on a door inscribed with sun and moon phases; the eye watches the shadows lengthen.

scenes.caption: The group waits for sunset, the glass diver calming the frightened townspeople.
scenes.visual_description: A few huddled figures in torn cloaks gather near the door; the glass diver speaks softly, his helmet reflecting their worried faces.

scenes.caption: The magic door swings open as the last light fades.
scenes.visual_description: Golden light spills from the doorway as the sun sets; Mara gestures, tin fox dashes through, oracle lamp bobs after.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols march down the main avenue.
scenes.visual_description: Silhouettes of marching figures in plate armor, torches held high, pass under tattered royal banners as the group hides in a niche.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector wakes and stumbles onto the escape bridge.
scenes.visual_description: He blinks, ledger still in hand, as he steps onto a stone bridge arching over a dry moat; the group follows cautiously.

scenes.caption: The glass diver dives through a mirror on the far side to seal the escape.
scenes.visual_description: At the bridge's end, a standing mirror reflects the ruined city; the glass diver leaps through, the surface ripples, then solidifies, leaving only the group on the safe side.
